The Router's visual identification of 'blending' is more reliable here than the mask confidence. The severity of 3.0 for the bench fusion is appropriate; it's a clear spatial grounding error. I also observe slight 'waxy' smoothing on the wooden carvings of the organ case, which the Router missed, suggesting a minor global texture anomaly (severity 1.5).
